correctness.rationale: The universal proof determines gcd(a,b)|2, gcd(b,c)|2, gcd(a,c)|35 by explicit congruences. All n>=6 are three-minimal because c<2a. The necessary-and-sufficient gluing criterion then excludes adjacent pair options through strict interval bounds, excludes endpoint options past n>=11/15/71 by odd-d nonintegral y, and checks the finite remaining residues n=10,12,40 explicitly. n=2..5 are handled directly. Independently computed exact Apéry genus and Frobenius for n=2..99 agree with the theorem; n=100..3000 further corroborate inequalities. No finite test is used as an infinite proof.
